data_description.outdoor_temp_sensor: Local weather station or outdoor module (e.g. Netatmo, Aqara). Overrides the weather entity temperature for adaptive away setpoint and season detection. Leave blank to use the weather entity.
data_description.night_setback_enabled: When enabled, the PID target temperature is reduced by the setback value during the configured night hours. Uses the existing night start/end hours.
data_description.night_setback_temp: Degrees Celsius subtracted from the Netatmo schedule setpoint during night hours. The setpoint will not go below the room away temperature.
data_description.house_voice_enabled: Requires the House Voice integration to be installed. When enabled, Heat Manager will announce events such as boost activation, season changes, and controller state changes.
data_description.pid_enabled: When disabled, TRVs follow the Netatmo/Zigbee schedule directly with no proportional adjustment.
data_description.pid_kp: Proportional gain — higher values react more aggressively to temperature error. Default 0.5.
data_description.pid_ki: Integral gain — corrects a persistent offset over time. Default 0.02. Keep small; large values cause overshoot.
data_description.pid_kd: Derivative gain — reacts to the rate of change. Disabled (0) by default: TRVs have several minutes of thermal lag, so a derivative term mostly amplifies sensor noise.
data_description.trv_max_temp: TRV setpoint sent when PID power is at 100%. Default 28°C.
data_description.indoor_wake_sensor: Shared indoor temperature sensor used to detect the gentler WAKING phase during spring/autumn. Falls back to full ACTIVE heating when not set.
data_description.indoor_wake_threshold: Indoor temperature above which the system enters the WAKING phase instead of full ACTIVE heating. Default 21°C.
data_description.wake_setback_temp: Degrees Celsius subtracted from every room's setpoint while in the WAKING phase. Default 2°C.

data_description.comfort_temp: PID target temperature for rooms with no HomeKit entity (Zigbee today, Matter/Thread later) — these have no separate cloud schedule to read a target from. Ignored for Netatmo rooms, which use the cloud entity's own schedule setpoint instead. Default 20°C.
data_description.co2_sensor: Used for context-aware window notifications and energy waste classification. When CO₂ is high, an open window is marked as ventilation rather than heat loss.
data_description.co2_threshold: CO₂ level above which an open window is classified as intentional ventilation. Default is 900 ppm. Increase for bedrooms (higher tolerance) or decrease for seldom-occupied rooms.
data_description.room_temp_sensor: Independent room probe for PID temperature feedback. Recommended for Zigbee TRVs whose built-in sensor sits on the radiator body (typically reads 1–3°C too high).

missing_climate_entity.description:
The climate entity `{climate_id}` configured for room **{room_name}** does not exist in Home Assistant. Heat Manager cannot control heating for this room until the entity is available.

To resolve: check that the integration providing `{climate_id}` is loaded and the entity ID is correct. Reload Heat Manager once the entity is available.
